div.head: II Em 7.2
div.ab: Ðonne he ðæs beweddad hæbbe, ðonne finde he ðærto wærborh.
Ðonne he ðæs beweddad hæbbe, ðone finde he ðærto wæreborh.
Et quando uadiauerit eam, inueniat wereplegios.
Ðonne he ðæs beweddad hæbbe, ðone finde he ðærto wæreborh.
When he has pledged himself to this, he shall find a surety for the payment of the wergeld.
When he has pledged this, he is to find surety for the wergild.
Nachdem er sich darauf verpflichtet hat, dann finde er dazu [für Zahlung des] Wergelds Bürgschaft.
When he has pledged himself to that, then let him find surety for [payment of] the wergild for it.
